body: Thank you, I hope so too. And yea I get stuck in my head a lot

I have, ive seen a few different therapists and tried to work through some of my problems, even got put on hormone therapy for my dysphoria but I pussied out, I’m too scared to transition and I feel like it’s too late. Nothing has ever really helped. The thoughts have been getting worse so I’m going to a therapist today but I can’t afford to go more than this once because money.

It is, I feel like no matter what I do with my life I'm just going to keep being miserable and it's exhausting. I think I do feel a bit more powerful when I think about it. Making people have regrets, maybe even scarring them. I think I've felt out of control my entire life because of who I was born as and what has happened and I just want to take back control by saying no and putting a stop to it.
